title: Spatial Change: Continuity, Reversibility, and Emergent Shapes
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Spatial change is examined through three connected questions: can successive descriptions remain compatible, can a change be reversed, and can the part to change be recognized? Shape arithmetic links these questions.
prerequisites: Undergraduate algebra and linear algebra; additional prerequisites in topic notes

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Author-hosted paper: introduction and the sections on continuity, reversibility and recognition. The central arguments and illustrative cases were reviewed; the full technical case classification has not been independently verified.
